info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Compliance Amendments API
info.description: The Compliance Amendments API enables users to modify existing compliance report submissions effectively. By allowing amendments to submissions identified by a unique submission ID, this API facilitates compliance adjustments in real-time, ensuring accuracy and adherence to regulations. It is designed for banking and financial institutions that need to update compliance documentation in response to regulatory changes or internal reviews. Typical consumers include compliance officers and reporting specialists who handle compliance submissions and regulatory audits.

post.summary: Create an amendment for a specific compliance submission.
post.description: This operation allows users to create an amendment for the compliance submission identified by the given ID. Amendments can be used to update or correct information in the original submission, ensuring compliance records are accurate and up to date.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer authentication mechanism, which involves sending a JSON Web Token (JWT) as a bearer token in the request's Authorization header. The JWT should be obtained from the authentication server and must be included in protected requests to validate the user's identity and access rights.
